equation_of_state: w(a) = w0 + wa (1 - a) (Eq. 1, l.66); a = 1/(1+z); LCDM is (w0, wa) = (-1, 0). Phantom means w < -1. 'Today' is a = 1 (w = w0); 'early times' is a -> 0 (w -> w0 + wa).
pivot: w_p = w0 + wa (1 - a_p) (Eq. 2, l.74). Decorrelation pivot (DETF, Albrecht et al. 2006, the definition DESI VI uses, l.912 of its TeX): 1 - a_p = -Cov(w0, wa)/Var(wa) from the weighted posterior samples; z_p = 1/a_p - 1; sigma(w_p)^2 = Var(w0) - Cov(w0, wa)^2/Var(wa). The paper's fixed pivots a_p = 0.79 (z 0.26) and 0.75 (z 0.33) are used where a claim names them; both are reported.
zones: Z1 always phantom: w0 < -1 and w0 + wa < -1. Z2 never phantom: w0 >= -1 and w0 + wa >= -1. Z3 phantom today only (non-phantom early): w0 < -1 and w0 + wa >= -1. Z4 phantom early only: w0 >= -1 and w0 + wa < -1. (w(a) is linear in a, so it is phantom at all a in (0, 1] iff it is at both ends.)
crossing: a_x = 1 + (1 + w0)/wa (w(a_x) = -1), defined for wa != 0; the crossing is in the past when 0 < a_x <= 1; z_x = 1/a_x - 1. rho_de(a) proportional to a^(-3(1 + w0 + wa)) exp(-3 wa (1 - a)); d ln rho_de / d ln a = -3 (1 + w(a)).
chains: DESI public Cobaya MCMC chains (datasets.json). Burn-in: the first 30% of each chain file removed (getdist ignore_rows = 0.3); variant 0.5 reported. Weights as in the files. Convergence: getdist Gelman-Rubin R - 1 over the chain files, reported (DESI's criterion is R - 1 < 0.01). Posterior summaries: weighted mean and standard deviation; 68% intervals equal-tail; 2D credible regions from getdist's default 2D density (the plotting method of DESI VI's figures), contour levels 0.68 and 0.95.
map_sample: The 'best fit' read from a chain is the sample with the largest posterior (smallest minuslogpost); it approximates the MAP and is labelled as such, never as DESI's minimiser result.
priors_reference: pi0, the DESI VI prior: uniform on B = {w0 in [-3, 1], wa in [-3, 2], w0 + wa < 0}, area 15.5 (other parameters' priors unchanged and common to every variant).
prior_variants: Alternative priors are tapers t(w0, wa) in [0, 1] on B: pi_T = pi0 t / E_pi0[t]. T1: phantom taper s = 0.5: w_min = min(w0, w0 + wa) (the lowest w over 0 < a <= 1); t = 1 if w_min >= -1, else exp(-(w_min + 1)^2 / (2 s^2)). T2: the same with s = 0.25. T3: centred on LCDM: t = exp(-(w0 + 1)^2/(2 * 0.5^2) - wa^2/(2 * 1.0^2)). T4: T3 with widths 0.25 and 0.5. T5: never-phantom (quintessence) prior: t = 1 on Z2, 0 elsewhere.
bayes_factor_shift: For a prior variant T, Z_T = Z_0 E_post0[t]/E_pi0[t] exactly (importance weighting; Z_LCDM does not change), so Delta ln B = ln E_post0[t] - ln E_pi0[t], B = Z(w0waCDM)/Z(LCDM). E_post0 from the chain samples (weights times t); E_pi0[t] by quadrature on B (2001 x 2001 grid) checked by Monte Carlo (10^7 points). Uncertainty of E_post0[t]: from the spread over chain files. DESI VI's ln B (0.65, 2.4, 2.8, PolyChord) is taken as printed for the anchor ln B_T = ln B_DESI + Delta ln B. Where no sample has t > 0, an upper bound with one effective sample is reported.
lcdm_level: Credible level of LCDM under a prior: Gaussian approximation in (w0, wa) with the (re)weighted mean and covariance: d^2 = Mahalanobis distance of (-1, 0), level = 1 - exp(-d^2/2), n sigma = sqrt(2) erfinv(level). The point sits in the tail beyond the sampled region for some combinations, so no density estimate is used there. 1D: (0 - mean(wa))/sd(wa) also reported.
sigma_conversion: Likelihood ratio with k extra parameters: p = 1 - CDF_chi2(-Delta chi2_MAP; k), n sigma = sqrt(2) erfinv(1 - p) (two-sided Gaussian equivalent); k = 2 for w0waCDM vs LCDM.
